Check notes, 14 October 2026

Run on Paolo’s laptop (Windows 11, R 4.5.1, roxygen2 8.0.0, mirt 1.44.0). Build and check ran in %TEMP%\caliber_check, smoke runs in %TEMP%\caliber_smoke\<run> (both outside the project).

The package was first written as monocal and renamed to caliber on 14 October at Paolo’s request (folder, R/caliber-package.R, all references, MONOCAL_OUT -> CALIBER_OUT).

R CMD check

R CMD check --no-manual caliber_0.1.0.tar.gz: Status: OK (0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes). Tests and both vignettes pass.

Fixes

  1. R/caliber-package.R: roxygen2 8 rejects a two-line @importFrom, so it is now split into two lines. The first check gave 2 NOTEs, now fixed:
    • scenario_truth() called gauss.quad.prob() without importing it. That would have been a runtime error. Added @importFrom statmod gauss.quad.prob.
    • hcl.colors, head and tail were not imported. Added @importFrom grDevices hcl.colors and @importFrom utils head tail, and put grDevices in Imports.
  2. NAMESPACE is now generated by roxygen, with the same 43 exports as the hand-written file (backup at %TEMP%\monocal_NAMESPACE_handwritten.bak). roxygen replaced RoxygenNote with Config/roxygen2/version: 8.0.0 and, after the rename, swapped man/monocal-package.Rd for man/caliber-package.Rd.
  3. R/intervals.R: on a PSOCK cluster (the scripts’ default), ms_bootstrap() failed every resample and then crashed (attempt to set an attribute on NULL). There were two causes:
    • summary_fun in the scripts is a global closure that uses script globals (items, eta_report, curve_grid), and the workers did not have them. The original ms scripts clusterExported these objects. Now global_refs() collects the global objects that summary_fun refers to (also through global functions it calls), and run_jobs(..., export =) exports them.
    • seed and the other arguments were unevaluated promises pointing at the global env. They are now force()d. A failed resample now returns its error message, and if every resample fails the function stops with the first error. The method is unchanged.

The only warnings were “package built under R 4.5.2/4.5.3” (patchwork, lavaan).

Reproduction (point columns: iter, df, sigma0, g1, mu_*, -2logL)

  • Gait (gait_comparison.csv vs ms/data/, main and _noaids): all differences 0.
  • Sleep (ms_step1_comparison.csv vs ms/_frozen_2026-10-08/data/):
    • MS-EAP and MS-Fixed: at most 1e-13.
    • MS-Joint: same iteration count (1099). Largest differences 2.1e-5 (mu_m3), 5.8e-6 (df), 3.7e-6 (sigma0), 3.5e-6 (-2logL); relative difference at most 1.4e-5.
    • Refitting MS-Joint on this laptop with the original ms/R/ms_functions.R gives exactly the package’s fit (a, d, df, sigma0 all identical). So the 2e-5 is a difference between the 8 Oct environment and today’s (for example the mirt version or numerics in the concurrent GRM updates), not a porting difference. It is far below the reported precision.

Left open

  • cleanup_moves_2026-10-14.ps1 was refused by the Claude Code permission classifier. It needs to be run by hand from the mapping folder. It only moves files, and R\ is excluded.
  • An older install named monocal is still in the user R library (remove.packages("monocal") if wanted).
